text:
jen: FYI partner 'BlueBox' just flagged a $12k negative adjustment from last month's marketplace export. they say it came from late minute batches being folded into hourly buckets and our rounding hedges. can ops/partners triage?

sam: ugh. do we have the exact raw events for that partner window? minute vs hourly aggregation mismatch sounds like a dedupe/merge order issue.

marta: i pulled logs — looks like we received multiple per-minute deltas with out-of-order timestamps. our hourly rollup does a last-write-wins on event_key which can flip usage net.

kai: quick question: is the partner sending both incremental and complete snapshots or only increments? that changes the reconciliation approach.

alex: BlueBox sends incrementals + occasional full snapshots (they said to reduce payload). the snapshot arrivals are sometimes delayed by ~7h.

jen: so root cause = late full snapshots + our hourly rollup idempotency model. impact = negative credits to customer invoices + partner dispute risk.

marta: i sketched a small repro and a conservative mitigation: when a full snapshot arrives we should prefer snapshot if timestamp > last_commit_ts and backfill the affected hour window with snapshot-derived state, not incremental patches.

sam: sounds right. two things to validate: 1) how big are the backfills (cost/IO) 2) idempotency key invariants so we don't double-apply.

kai: for (1) we can run a sampling job on last 90 days for partners that send snapshots. estimate: ~3500 hour-windows would need recompute, ~0.4 GPU-hours on our batch pipeline (i'll confirm). for (2) propose using combination (partner_id, window_start, snapshot_seq) as canonical key. snapshots include seq metadata?

alex: BlueBox includes a snapshot_seq header starting v2.3 of their connector. older partners might not. we need fallback.

recon-bot: automated note: created ticket PRJ-6721 to track "marketplace snapshot backfill workflow" and assigned to @marta. (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-6721) :robot_face:

marta: proposed rollback-safe playbook (high level):
- run a dry-run backfill job to compute delta per invoice period
- surface per-customer credit estimate to partnerships for approval
- run idempotent reconcile applying delta via ledger-service patch API (PATCH /partners/:id/usage/adjustments)
- emit audit events and notify billing-run team for the cutoff

jen: also need a short-term guardrail to prevent new occurrences: if we detect a snapshot arriving with timestamp older than existing hour state by >2h, mark as "delayed-snapshot" and queue for manual review instead of auto-apply.

sam: agree. we should also add an alert in the marketplace ingestion pipeline when reordering ratio > 0.5% for any partner over 24h.

kai: on dedupe/keying: incremental events currently use (event_id). but if a snapshot arrives that fully replaces an hour we must delete related incrementals in that hour. implement tombstone marker: tombstone_key=(partner_id, window_start, snapshot_seq). tombstones will be honored by rollup to ignore incrementals with older seq.

marta: i can PR the tombstone ingestion change. rough patch:
```
-- pseudo sql for rollup
with snapshot as (select partner_id, window_start, total_usage, snapshot_seq from snapshots where partner_id = :pid and window_start = :w)
insert into hourly_rollup (partner_id, window_start, usage, applied_snapshot_seq)
values (:pid, :w, snapshot.total_usage, snapshot.snapshot_seq)
on conflict (partner_id, window_start) do update
set usage = excluded.usage, applied_snapshot_seq = greatest(hourly_rollup.applied_snapshot_seq, excluded.applied_snapshot_seq);
```

jen: nice. make sure ledger-service patch is additive and compensating entries are created, so invoices can be reissued if needed.

alex: Ops note: we'll need an SLA handshake with BlueBox for snapshot latency. can partnerships ask them to include snapshot_seq in older connectors? might need product gating.

marta: next steps (owners):
- marta: open PR + small job to compute backfill size and dry-run (ETA 2 days)
- kai: estimate infra cost/IO + monitor alert rule (ETA 1 day)
- sam: coordinate ledger-service patch schema for compensating adjustments (ETA 3 days)
- jen: draft partner message + approval flow with legal (ETA 1 day)

sam: + add unit tests for tombstone behavior; will pair with marta.

alex: if bluebox agrees to snapshot_seq we can run a one-off reconciliation for last 6 months to clear outstanding deltas. partnership PM wants talking points.

jen: i'll draft talking points and hold a sync w/bluebox tomorrow 10am PT. thanks all. :thumbsup:
